blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Highlighting a growing defense and security partnership between the Philippines and the United States, Zamboanga del Sur provincial officials welcomed a delegation from the US Embassy on Tuesday for the ceremonial opening of a newly established specialized training facility at the Provincial Government Center (PGC) in Barangay Dao in this city. Zamboanga del Sur Gov. Divina Grace Yu, Congressman Joseph Kim Yu (1st District) and One Coop Party-list Rep. Maria Kristina Jihan Glepa led local leaders in receiving the U.S. contingent headed by Assistant Secretary Todd Wilcox of the U.S. Department of State’s Diplomatic Security. […]...
